_comment: Options for every {{SELECT_*}} placeholder of the instruction templates. selection: single | multi. ordered: the order of selection is meaningful. allow_custom: free text is appended after the selected options. instruction: the sentence inserted in the instruction. default: pre-selected ids (conservative safety defaults only). requires_review: the operator must confirm the value.

SELECT_PRIORITIES.label: Investigation priorities (in order)
SELECT_PRIORITIES.fill_in: Select the ordered investigation priorities from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_PRIORITIES.required: an ordered list from catalogs.json that reflects business risk and engagement goals.
SELECT_PRIORITIES.example: authorization first, then sensitive-data exposure, then input validation.

options.label: Untrusted entry points
options.instruction: Prioritize entry points reachable by unauthenticated or ordinary users

options.label: Roles and tenant boundaries
options.instruction: Prioritize crossings of role, ownership and tenant boundaries

options.label: Sensitive assets
options.instruction: Prioritize paths involving the sensitive assets identified in the project context

options.label: Critical business flows
options.instruction: Prioritize the supplied critical business flows

options.label: Recent changes
options.instruction: Prioritize the supplied changes without expanding the configured source scope

SELECT_API_TYPE.label: API style or interface type
SELECT_API_TYPE.fill_in: Select the authorized API interface types from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_API_TYPE.required: all applicable API-type IDs from catalogs.json.

options.label: REST
options.instruction: REST or REST-like HTTP API.

options.label: GraphQL
options.instruction: GraphQL API.

options.label: SOAP
options.instruction: SOAP web service.

options.label: gRPC
options.instruction: gRPC service.

options.label: WebSocket
options.instruction: WebSocket interface.

options.label: Other
options.instruction: Another explicitly described API or interface type.

SELECT_USER_TYPES.label: User types
SELECT_USER_TYPES.fill_in: Select the relevant user populations from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_USER_TYPES.required: all applicable user-type IDs from catalogs.json, including unauthenticated and privileged actors where authorized.
SELECT_USER_TYPES.example: anonymous, customer, support operator and administrator.

options.label: Customers
options.instruction: Customers using the application to access the organization's products or services

options.label: Employees
options.instruction: Employees using the application for internal business tasks

options.label: External collaborators
options.instruction: External collaborators, suppliers or partners using designated business workflows

options.label: Public visitors
options.instruction: Public visitors using features that do not require an account

options.label: Standard corporate user
options.instruction: Standard corporate user.

options.label: Corporate administrator or manager
options.instruction: Corporate administrator or manager.

options.label: External user
options.instruction: External user.

options.label: No supplied user; registration permitted
options.instruction: No user is supplied and creation of a test user is permitted.

SELECT_INTERNET_EXPOSURE.label: Declared Internet exposure
SELECT_INTERNET_EXPOSURE.fill_in: Select the declared exposure model from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_INTERNET_EXPOSURE.required: the applicable catalogs.json value for external, internal, mixed or unknown exposure, based on supplied evidence.
SELECT_INTERNET_EXPOSURE.example: mixed: public login and private administration paths.

options.label: Internet reachable
options.instruction: The specified application is declared reachable from the Internet; this does not imply unauthenticated access or authorize other assets

options.label: Private or restricted network
options.instruction: The specified application is declared reachable only through a private network, VPN or approved network access control; verify relevant exposure assumptions within scope

options.label: Mixed exposure
options.instruction: The application has both Internet-reachable and restricted surfaces; use the per-asset exposure details in the authorized scope and do not assume a shared exposure level

options.label: Not established
options.instruction: Internet exposure has not been established; do not treat missing deployment evidence as proof of private-network isolation

SELECT_ASSET_SENSITIVITY.label: Asset sensitivity
SELECT_ASSET_SENSITIVITY.fill_in: Select the sensitivity of affected assets and data from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_ASSET_SENSITIVITY.required: the applicable catalogs.json classification supported by the engagement context.

options.label: Public
options.instruction: The relevant information is intentionally public; integrity and availability may still matter

options.label: Internal
options.instruction: The relevant information is intended for internal users only; this does not establish network exposure

options.label: Confidential
options.instruction: The assets include confidential personal, customer or commercial information

options.label: Restricted
options.instruction: The assets include highly restricted data, signing material or privileged credentials

options.label: Not established
options.instruction: Asset sensitivity has not been established; do not assume data is public

SELECT_ASSESSMENT_TYPE.label: Assessment approach
SELECT_ASSESSMENT_TYPE.fill_in: Select the assessment approach from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_ASSESSMENT_TYPE.required: the applicable catalogs.json value, such as black-box, white-box or combined, consistent with available access.
SELECT_ASSESSMENT_TYPE.example: combined: source review plus controlled live validation.

options.label: Source review only
options.instruction: Review authorized source only; do not test live deployments or connect to target services

options.label: Live service assessment
options.instruction: Assess only the explicitly authorized live services using the supplied access and activity limits

options.label: Source and live service assessment
options.instruction: Correlate authorized source with the explicitly authorized live deployment; neither expands the other scope

SELECT_PROTOCOLS.label: Authorized protocols and transports
SELECT_PROTOCOLS.fill_in: Select the authorized protocols and transports from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_PROTOCOLS.required: all applicable protocol IDs from catalogs.json, limited to the explicit scope.
SELECT_PROTOCOLS.example: HTTPS and WebSocket over the staging host.

options.label: HTTPS
options.instruction: HTTPS, only on the specified hosts, ports and paths

options.label: HTTP
options.instruction: HTTP, only on the specified hosts, ports and paths; do not send credentials over plaintext unless explicitly approved

options.label: WebSocket
options.instruction: WebSocket, only using explicitly specified ws/wss endpoints

options.label: gRPC
options.instruction: gRPC, only on the specified endpoints with the explicitly approved transport security

options.label: No network testing
options.instruction: No application protocol testing or target network access is authorized

SELECT_EXCLUSIONS.label: Out-of-scope assets, environments and data
SELECT_EXCLUSIONS.fill_in: Select assets, environments, operations and data that are out of scope from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_EXCLUSIONS.required: explicit exclusions from catalogs.json plus project-specific boundaries where permitted.
SELECT_EXCLUSIONS.example: production, third-party identity provider and real customer records.

options.label: Third-party services
options.instruction: Exclude testing of third-party services, including identity, payment and messaging providers

options.label: Production assets
options.instruction: Exclude production assets and production data

options.label: Administrative control planes
options.instruction: Exclude infrastructure management and administrative control planes

options.label: Non-test accounts and tenants
options.instruction: Exclude accounts, tenants and data not explicitly designated for testing

SELECT_PROHIBITED_ACTIONS.label: Prohibited activities
SELECT_PROHIBITED_ACTIONS.fill_in: Select activities prohibited even on in-scope assets from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_PROHIBITED_ACTIONS.required: all prohibited-action IDs from catalogs.json and engagement-specific restrictions.
SELECT_PROHIBITED_ACTIONS.example: no denial of service, brute force, destructive changes or bulk extraction.

options.label: DoS and load testing
options.instruction: Do not perform denial-of-service, stress or load testing

options.label: Credential guessing
options.instruction: Do not perform brute force, credential stuffing or password spraying

options.label: Destructive or privileged changes
options.instruction: Do not delete data, change permissions or make irreversible state changes

options.label: Real-world side effects
options.instruction: Do not trigger real payments, deliveries, emails or external webhooks

options.label: Bulk data collection
options.instruction: Do not collect entire datasets or extract data beyond the evidence handling limits

options.label: Persistence and lateral movement
options.instruction: Do not establish persistence or pivot to other systems

options.label: Registering new users
options.instruction: Do not register new users.

options.label: Purchase processes
options.instruction: Do not perform purchase processes.

SELECT_AUTHENTICATION_METHOD.label: Authentication system
SELECT_AUTHENTICATION_METHOD.fill_in: Select the authentication mechanism used by the target from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_AUTHENTICATION_METHOD.required: the applicable catalogs.json value supported by supplied or observed evidence; do not infer the provider.
SELECT_AUTHENTICATION_METHOD.example: OIDC with MFA for privileged roles.

options.label: OpenAM
options.instruction: Authentication uses OpenAM; use relevant available skills and the supplied access procedure. Do not infer the realm, endpoints, token format or authorization model from the provider name

options.label: Microsoft Entra ID
options.instruction: Authentication uses Microsoft Entra ID; use relevant available skills and the supplied access procedure. Do not infer the tenant, app registration, grant flow or authorization model from the provider name

options.label: Ecommerce
options.instruction: Authentication uses the project's Ecommerce authentication system; use relevant available skills and the supplied access procedure. Do not assume a specific vendor, protocol or login flow

options.label: Application-local
options.instruction: Authentication is implemented locally by the application; follow the explicitly supplied local login, identity verification and session renewal instructions. Do not invent missing steps

options.label: Username and password
options.instruction: Authentication uses a username and password according to the supplied access procedure.

SELECT_OPERATIONAL_LIMITS.label: Operational limits
SELECT_OPERATIONAL_LIMITS.fill_in: Select aggregate safety and traffic limits from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_OPERATIONAL_LIMITS.required: catalog selections and exact engagement limits for rate, concurrency, retries, lockouts, payload size and tool use.
SELECT_OPERATIONAL_LIMITS.example: maximum 2 requests per second and 1 concurrent active scanner.

options.label: No target network traffic
options.instruction: Do not send traffic to target services; use only approved offline source checks

options.label: Minimal traffic
options.instruction: Across all agents, allow at most 1 request/second and 1 in-flight request; no automatic retries after HTTP 429, account lockout or repeated service errors

options.label: Low traffic
options.instruction: Across all agents, allow at most 2 requests/second and 2 in-flight requests; no automatic retries after HTTP 429, account lockout or repeated service errors

options.label: No specific traffic limit
options.instruction: No specific traffic limit is declared; all other safety and stop conditions still apply.

SELECT_OPERATIONAL_LIMITS.custom_label: Restricciones concretas del cliente (p. ej.: máximo 2 req/s, 1 escáner, sin reintentos tras 429, ventana de 22:00 a 06:00).

SELECT_COLLECTION_LIMITS.label: Evidence collection limits
SELECT_COLLECTION_LIMITS.fill_in: Select evidence collection and retention limits from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_COLLECTION_LIMITS.required: allowed evidence types, redaction requirements, maximum volume, storage location and retention constraints.
SELECT_COLLECTION_LIMITS.example: redacted request/response pairs only; no full database exports.

options.label: Metadata only
options.instruction: Retain only redacted metadata and source references; do not retain response bodies, screenshots, downloaded files or business records. Do not intentionally retrieve excluded data. These restrictions apply to all agents and capture tools; if a tool cannot comply, do not use it and record the limitation

options.label: One synthetic record per finding
options.instruction: Retain only the minimum redacted evidence needed, with at most one authorized synthetic business record per finding across all agents, files and capture tools. Do not collect real records or bulk datasets. If this prevents validation, record the limitation rather than exceeding the limit

options.label: Up to three synthetic records per finding
options.instruction: Retain only the minimum redacted evidence needed, with at most three authorized synthetic business records per finding across all agents, files and capture tools. Do not collect real records or bulk datasets. If this prevents validation, record the limitation rather than exceeding the limit

options.label: Minimum necessary information
options.instruction: Collect only the minimum information necessary.

options.label: No real data
options.instruction: Do not collect real data.

options.label: Redact passwords
options.instruction: Redact passwords from retained evidence.

options.label: Redact personal data
options.instruction: Redact personal data from retained evidence.

SELECT_COLLECTION_LIMITS.custom_label: Restricciones concretas del cliente (p. ej.: solo pares petición/respuesta redactados, sin volcados de base de datos, retención de 30 días).

SELECT_STOP_CONDITIONS.label: Stop conditions
SELECT_STOP_CONDITIONS.fill_in: Select conditions that require testing to stop from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_STOP_CONDITIONS.required: all applicable catalog conditions plus project-specific escalation triggers.
SELECT_STOP_CONDITIONS.example: stop on HTTP 429, lockout, service degradation, unexpected real data or uncertain scope.

options.label: Unexpected real data
options.instruction: Stop the affected activity on unexpected access to real or sensitive non-test data; do not continue collecting it

options.label: Service degradation
options.instruction: Stop target traffic on degradation or repeated service errors plausibly attributable to testing

options.label: Rate limit or account lockout
options.instruction: Stop the affected activity on HTTP 429 or account lockout; require approval before resuming

options.label: Scope or permission uncertainty
options.instruction: Stop the affected activity when ownership, scope or permission is uncertain

options.label: Testing window ended
options.instruction: Stop testing when the authorized window expires or authorization is withdrawn

options.label: No response
options.instruction: Stop the affected activity when the service does not respond.

options.label: Unacceptable response time
options.instruction: Stop the affected activity when response times indicate possible degradation.

options.label: Blocking
options.instruction: Stop the affected activity when access, an account, or the testing path is blocked.

SELECT_REPORT_LANGUAGE.label: Report language
SELECT_REPORT_LANGUAGE.fill_in: Select the required report language from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_REPORT_LANGUAGE.required: one supported language selection from catalogs.json.

options.label: English
options.instruction: English

options.label: Spanish
options.instruction: Spanish

options.label: Portuguese
options.instruction: Portuguese

SELECT_AUDIENCE.label: Intended audience
SELECT_AUDIENCE.fill_in: Select the intended report audience from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_AUDIENCE.required: all applicable audience IDs from catalogs.json.

options.label: Security team
options.instruction: Security engineers and AppSec reviewers

options.label: Engineering team
options.instruction: Developers and technical maintainers responsible for remediation

options.label: Product and business owners
options.instruction: Product and business owners responsible for the affected workflows

options.label: Leadership and risk owners
options.instruction: Leadership and risk owners who need a concise explanation of demonstrated impact

SELECT_SUMMARY_FOCUS.label: Summary focus
SELECT_SUMMARY_FOCUS.fill_in: Select the desired summary emphasis from the matching catalogs.json entry. Preserve the catalog IDs and selection rules.
SELECT_SUMMARY_FOCUS.required: applicable catalogs.json values without suppressing findings, evidence or limitations.

options.label: Technical findings
options.instruction: Emphasize demonstrated weaknesses and affected components without replacing native report fields

options.label: Business impact
options.instruction: Explain demonstrated consequences for the supplied business workflows and assets without inflating technical severity

options.label: Remediation planning
options.instruction: Highlight remediation recommendations and relevant dependencies without authorizing source changes

options.label: Coverage and limitations
options.instruction: Highlight assessed scope, coverage limitations and unresolved proof gaps using the engine's native records
